name: Sprint gantt chart
description:
**Conversation Summary**

1. **Request:** Build a Gantt visualization for the sprint board derived from task data, showing status and useful notes/info — styled after the attached reference image.
2. **Analysis:** Explored the kanban store/board structure — sprint tasks are chats grouped into columns by `status`, with usable fields `created_at`, `deadline`, `updated_at`, `cost`, `estimation_cost`, `users`, and `parent_id` (subtasks).
3. **Design decision:** Since no explicit start/end dates exist, the Gantt derives the schedule (`created_at` → start; `deadline`/completion/today → end) and progress (status + subtask completion ratio).
4. **Delivered (new):** `SprintBoardGantt.vue` — sticky left task table (status dot, deadline/cost/subtask notes, avatars, progress ring) plus a scrollable timeline with month/day headers, weekend shading, today marker, status-coloured bars with progress fills, milestones, legend with counts, overdue badge, zoom levels and jump-to-today.
5. **Delivered (update):** `SprintBoardView.vue` — added a Board/Gantt view toggle and conditional rendering, reusing `filteredColumns` so search filters both views while all modals and handlers remain unchanged.

messages.content:
Create a gantt visualization for the sprint board based on the tasks.
See attached image as example. We must show status and useful notes/info for the user

I'll start by exploring the project structure and the existing kanban board implementation to understand the patterns, data model, and components before proposing the Gantt visualization.Let me read the key files to understand data model and integration points.Let me examine the kanban store to understand the sprint column/task structure and status config.The kanban store wasn't clearly located. Let me find it directly.I have enough understanding of the data model and the board structure. Here's my plan. ## Summary of understanding - Sprint tasks are chat objects grouped into **columns by `status`** (`todo/doing/onhold/done/rejected`) via `$storex.kanban.sprintColumns(boardId)`, exposed to `SprintBoardView` as `columns` → `filteredColumns`. - Useful task fields available: `name`, `status`, `created_at`, `updated_at`, `deadline`, `cost`, `estimation_cost`, `users` (assignees), `parent_id` (subtasks via `$storex.chats.chatChildren`). - No explicit start/end dates exist, so a Gantt must **derive a schedule** (`created_at` → start, `deadline`/`updated_at`/today → end) and **derive progress** from status + subtask completion. ## Change proposal 1. **New `SprintBoardGantt.vue`** — a self-contained, dependency-free Gantt: sticky left task table (status dot, deadline/cost/subtask notes, avatars, progress ring) + horizontally scrollable timeline (month + day header, weekend/grid shading, today marker, status-coloured bars with progress fill, milestones, per-row status groups). Toolbar has status legend, overdue count, zoom levels and a "jump to today" button. 2. **Update `SprintBoardView.vue`** — add a **Board / Gantt** view switch in the toolbar and render the Gantt (feeding it the same `filteredColumns`, so search works in both views). ## Changes summary | File | Change | |------|--------| | `src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardGantt.vue` | **New** Gantt visualization component | | `src/components/kanban/board/SprintBoardView.vue` | Import + `activeView` state + toolbar switch + conditional render | Now the view integration: ## What changed & why - **`SprintBoardGantt.vue` (new)** — a self-contained, dependency-free Gantt: - **Left table**: status dot, task name, and a "notes" line (deadline · cost · subtasks), avatars (≤3 + `+N`), and a progress ring (`%`). - **Timeline**: month + day header, weekend/grid shading via CSS gradients (no DOM bloat), a **today marker**, and status-coloured bars with a progress **fill**. Completed same-day tasks render as **milestones** (diamond). - **Status lives everywhere**: group rows per sprint column/status, bar colours per status, and a legend with counts + an **overdue** chip. - **Schedule derivation** from `created_at`/`deadline`/`updated_at`; progress from status + subtask completion ratio. - **Zoom levels** (compact/normal/wide) and a **jump-to-today** button; rows are click-to-open (`Ctrl/Cmd` → open in window). - **`SprintBoardView.vue`** — added a **Board / Gantt** segmented toggle and conditional rendering, reusing the existing `filteredColumns` so the search filters both views. Everything else (modals, move/subtask/remove handlers, stats) is untouched. ### Quick usage notes - `deadline` drives bar length where present; tasks without one extend to *today* (ongoing) or stop at their completion date (done) — so the chart stays meaningful even with sparse data. - The window is capped at 180 days (Monday-aligned) so a very old task can't blow up the timeline; out-of-range bars are clamped to the edges.
